text:
[LEXP.5.3.1] Overloaded by arity: 2D takes 4 operands, 3D takes 6.

| Function | Arity | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `euclidean(x1, y1, x2, y2)` | 2D | L₂ distance |
| `euclidean(x1, y1, z1, x2, y2, z2)` | 3D | L₂ distance |
| `manhattan(x1, y1, x2, y2)` | 2D | L₁ distance (taxicab) |
| `manhattan(x1, y1, z1, x2, y2, z2)` | 3D | L₁ distance |
| `chebyshev(x1, y1, x2, y2)` | 2D | L∞ distance (chessboard) |
| `chebyshev(x1, y1, z1, x2, y2, z2)` | 3D | L∞ distance |
